query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `yield_alert_thresholds` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `metricType` enum('FPY','FY','NTF','UPH') NOT NULL,
  `warningThreshold` decimal(10,4) NOT NULL,
  `criticalThreshold` decimal(10,4) NOT NULL,
  `targetValue` decimal(10,4),
  `comparisonOperator` enum('gt','lt','gte','lte') DEFAULT 'gte' NOT NULL,
  `isEnabled` boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  `notifyOnWarning` boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  `notifyOnCritical` boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  `description` text,
  `createdAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  `updatedAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);
